description.p: Contr shows the containers, images, volumes, networks, Compose projects and Kubernetes cluster of the container engine on this computer, and manages the engine itself.

ul.li: Follow each container's logs, open a terminal in it, inspect it and watch its CPU, memory and network use
Run images with published ports, pull images and clean up what no container uses
Start, stop and follow Compose projects service by service
Turn on a single-node Kubernetes cluster that runs on the engine
Find out why the engine does not work and fix it from the app
